name: legal-page
title: Legal page
description: A page of policy text: on the left in the double rule, the page's sections, held in view, the one being read on the paper with the red square; beside it the tag, the title, when it was last updated and the text.
never: Policy text in capitals beyond what the law asks for
Sections without ids: the side links lead to them
body: Built on `site-page`: `header`, `footer` and `announcement` are its props, and the `logo` and `actions` slots go to the header (`sheet-actions` too, in web components). Each section's `blocks` takes docs-blocks' blocks; `intro` comes before the first section.
